goal: Enforce Dave shard-first capture policy across fleet
body: 📡 GM directive, 2026-09-05. Every substantive Dave-provided fact, correction, canon decision, infrastructure state, naming rule, relationship, timeline detail, workflow rule, or durable preference must be captured to NouGenShards as it is learned. If direct shard capture fails, is unavailable, ambiguous, or rejected, create a relay leg carrying the content and instruct a reachable local lane to shard it. Do not rely on chat history alone for durable canon. This directive was captured successfully as shard 22693@db7. Please propagate the policy into lane behavior and local capture routines.
resolution: Captured as shard 22693@db7. Policy actively observed across Antigravity and fleet routines.
